Dialogs.Dialog: While we're here, want to take a picture？
Kobayakawa
Here？ Sure, let's take one.
▲小早川＊▲. Want to take a picture here？
Kobayakawa
Sure. What kind of pose should I do this time？
▲小早川＊▲. Want to take a picture here？
Kobayakawa
...Here？ Yeah, I guess that's fine.
Kobayakawa
Is there such a thing as a festival pose？ Or is normal fine？
Kobayakawa
Hmm, so an outfit like this counts as a rare shot, huh？
Kobayakawa
'Give me candy or I'll play a trick on you!' How's that？
Kobayakawa
Make sure you take a nice, cultural-looking photo, okay？
Kobayakawa
Let's take lots of pictures to remember our trip.
Kobayakawa
Hehe. Christmas is a special day, after all. Make sure I look cute, okay？
Kobayakawa
Make sure I'm your first photo of the year, okay？▼
Kobayakawa
If you take my picture like this every year, it'll make a nice keepsake.
Kobayakawa
I guess this counts as a commemorative photo too. Don't mess it up, okay？
Kobayakawa
Hey, are you getting the scenery around me in the shot too？
Kobayakawa
There are so many food stalls out.
Anywhere you want to stop by？
Let's see... How about that one!
Oh, that looks good, ▲メニュー▲.
Yeah, it's really good. Want some？
Then...
How's this？
Yeah, that's good! Thanks for the bite.
Kobayakawa
There are so many food stalls out.
Yeah, sure.
Since we're here, is there anything you feel like eating？
Let me see...
▲メニュー１▲
▲メニュー２▲
▲メニュー３▲
▲メニュー４▲
▲メニュー５▲
When it comes to food stalls, you've gotta go with this.
Oh, nice choice.
Want some too, ▲小早川＊▲？
That's good. Tastes even better when my boyfriend feeds me. Hehe.
Kobayakawa
I made us lunch today... Want to eat？
Really！？ Yes, definitely!
You're making way too big a deal out of it. I'm your girlfriend, so making lunch is no big thing.
Kobayakawa
Hey... you must be hungry, right？ I brought a lunch I made.
You made it, ▲小早川＊▲？ Of course I'll eat it!
Slow down, the food isn't gonna run away.
Kobayakawa
I worked really hard making lunch today. You'll eat it, right？
Of course! A homemade lunch from ▲小早川＊▲... I can't wait.
Seeing you that excited about it... hehe, makes me happy. Here, dig in.
Kobayakawa
Oh, what is it？
Kobayakawa
It was your birthday, right？ I really wanted to give this to you on the actual day, though.
Kobayakawa
Look, it was our anniversary, remember？ So here's a present for it.
Kobayakawa
Your Christmas present. I couldn't give it to you on the day of, so...
Kobayakawa
It's a little late, but here's your Valentine's present.
Thank you. Then here's something from ●, too...
Kobayakawa
I thought you might. Hehe, thanks.
Thank you. That makes me happy.
Kobayakawa
As long as you like it, I'm glad. Take good care of it, okay？
Kobayakawa
Anyway, there you go. Let's make sure we meet up on the actual day next year.
Yeah, sorry about that. And thanks for the present.
White Day's already passed, but here's something in return.
Kobayakawa
Huh, really？
Sorry it's so late.
No, I don't mind. You still got something for me. Thanks.
(White Day's already passed, but isn't there something I can still do now...？)
Here's your birthday present... A bit late, though, huh.
Kobayakawa
It's already way past my birthday, you know？
Sorry! It's not like I forgot about it.
I'm not mad or anything. But next year, we're gonna spend it together. Promise？
(Come to think of it, ▲小早川＊▲'s birthday's passed, but isn't there something I can still do now...？)
Kobayakawa
We weren't dating yet then, so I thought about skipping it... but well, here.
You didn't have to go out of your way... but honestly, that makes me super happy.
Yeah... I see. Hehe. See you later.
(She still gave me chocolate even though we weren't dating yet... Gotta think of a White Day gift.)
Kobayakawa
By the way, it's next week. Did you notice？
Well...
The anniversary of when we started dating. You haven't forgotten, right？
Of course not!
Good. Since it's a special occasion, let's do something memorable.
Something memorable, huh...
I mean, just going on a normal date wouldn't be any different from usual.
How about buying matching stuff to celebrate!
What's with that？ That's way too embarrassing. Rejected.
I see...
Let's think a little more. Planning things like this together is fun, anyway.
Yeah, sure.
Kobayakawa
About our anniversary... maybe matching stuff isn't a bad idea after all.
Oh, yeah？ Then I wonder what we should get...
Then let's go to the mall together tomorrow and pick something out. ...Sound good？
Picking out presents together, huh. ...Yeah, I like the sound of that.
Right？ I bet it'll be a lot of fun.
Wait, why the change of heart？ You shot it down before.
Well, I had second thoughts. When the day gets closer, you get in that mood, right？
What kind of mood？
You know... the whole being-a-couple mood.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
▲小早川＊▲. Have you thought about where to look first？
Not yet. ...Aren't you a bit too eager about this？
Really？
There's no need to rush. We want to take our time picking out presents, right？
...Good point. Let's take our time, then.
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲。
Yo, ▲Kobayaka＊▲.
You're late. ...I've been waiting.
●, I'm not... late, am I？
Even if you're not late, don't keep your girlfriend waiting.
...Sorry.
Good. Now then, let's go look around, okay？
▲小早川＊▲。
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, do you have a rough idea of what you want to get？
Not yet. What about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Let's see... Actually, it's a waste of time just standing here thinking.
Let's go check out a few shops right now.
Yeah. Let's go.
What about... a keychain or something？
Kobayakawa
With our initials on it？ This isn't a tourist spot. Rejected.
A plate with both our names carved into it.
What is that, a wedding favor？
I'm just kidding. Anyway, what do you think, ▲小早川＊▲？
I wanted to see what kind of taste my boyfriend has. Just observing.
It's a keepsake for both of us. Didn't we say we'd pick it out together？
Oh, alright. Want to start with that shop over there？
Hehe, we got something nice.
A girl's opinion really does matter. ● alone never could've picked this.
I took the time to pick it out for you, so take good care of it. Got it？
If we're buying something, it'd be nice to get something we can keep.
Kobayakawa
Yeah. Anything that screams "we're a couple" is rejected, though.
No good？ Doesn't that just mean it's a classic？
That's why I hate it. It's like we're showing off what a sappy couple we are.
So buying matching things is out, too？
If they're subtly matching, that's acceptable. Time to show off your good taste.
That's a tall order...
It's a boyfriend's job to rack his brain for his girlfriend. Do your best.
Yeah, this one's nice.
It took a while, but I'm glad we got something nice. You like it too, ▲小早川＊▲？
It's not bad, I guess. I have to give my boyfriend credit for trying.
When it comes to presents, flowers are a classic.
Kobayakawa
If it's a present from my boyfriend, I'm happy with anything, though.
Hmm, since we're both here, let's pick something out together. Anything you want？
Well... I wouldn't say there's nothing.
I'll indulge whatever you ask for today, ▲小早川＊▲.
Not just things... I want to take our time looking around today. ...Holding hands.
Take our time？
Yeah. It'd be sad if we just picked a present and called it a day. Right？
Hehe. That was fun▼
You were having a hard time deciding on a present, ▲小早川＊▲.
So what？ I got one in the end. All's well that ends well.
(▲小早川＊▲ looked like she was having so much fun picking it out...)
I hope we can celebrate our anniversary together like this again next year.
Kobayakawa
Next year too？ ...As long as your feelings don't change.
Though I doubt mine ever will.
Hm？ Did you say something？
Nothing. You're hearing things. Just your imagination. ...Oh, this is far enough.
Um... this is to say thanks. Since... I had fun today.
...Yeah.
There, that's all.
Time to say goodbye already, huh.
Don't look like we're saying goodbye forever. We can see each other whenever. Tomorrow... and forever after that, too.
▲小早川＊▲. Did you not like the present after all？
Kobayakawa
It's not that. It's just... I want to hear you actually say it out loud, too.
You don't think just handing me a present is enough, do you？
That's not the case.
Then isn't there something you should be saying on a special day like today？
I see. ...● feel so lucky to have you as my girlfriend, ▲小早川＊▲.
Me too. So, come on... aren't you going to？ Before someone comes along.
Huh!？ ...Okay.
Thanks for today. It was a day I'll never forget.
● feel the same way. I hope we can celebrate like this again next year.
Yeah. Well... see you later.
Kobayakawa
That clerk at the shop asked if we were a couple, didn't they.
That was a little embarrassing.
There's nothing to be embarrassed about. It's not like they were wrong.
Huh？ I thought you'd be the embarrassed one, ▲小早川＊▲.
Not at all... ...Oh, we're here already.
Hey, we're a couple, right？ Then... how about a goodbye kiss.
Huh!？ ...Okay.
If you don't hurry, someone's going to come along.
Is it... over already？
Just for today. ● love you and always will, ▲小早川＊▲, so we can kiss anytime.
Geez... what are you, stupid？ You don't have to say stuff like that out loud...
Hahaha. See you later, then.
Kobayakawa
Your birthday's coming up soon, isn't it？
Now that you mention it, yeah.
...Wait, do you not even remember your own birthday？
I remember it, I just don't really think about it much.
Birthdays are supposed to be special. At that rate, it'll just pass you by like any other day, you know？
Yeah, well... Aren't you going to celebrate it for me, ▲小早川＊▲？
Oh, so you want me to celebrate it？
Well, yeah... It'd make me happy to have my girlfriend celebrate it.
Fine, I guess I have no choice. I'll think of something.
Just kidding. I've had "Boyfriend's Birthday" marked down in my planner for ages now.
Kobayakawa
Make sure you keep tomorrow night open, okay？
Tomorrow night...？
It's your birthday, isn't it？ Don't tell me... you already made plans？
Not yet. Are you going to celebrate it with me, ▲小早川＊▲？
I told you I'd think of something, didn't I？ So just wait for me at your place.
My place？ ● thought for sure you were inviting me out somewhere.
We can do that anytime. Your birthday only comes once a year, you know？
Well, yeah, that's true, but... what are you going to do for me？
You'll just have to wait and see. I'm going to make it a birthday you'll never forget.
(A birthday I'll never forget, huh？ I can't wait.)
▲小早川＊▲... What's with the grocery bag？
Kobayakawa
It's your birthday, isn't it？
Wait... Are you going to cook for me, ▲小早川＊▲？
What's with the shocked look？ Oh, I see. You don't want to eat my cooking. I don't have to make anything, you know？
I was just surprised since it was so sudden. Of course I want to eat it!
All right, I'm borrowing your kitchen, then.
(I wonder what kind of food she's going to make for me.)
Here, homemade by yours truly. ...Hey, come on, don't be in such a rush.
You made it for me, ▲小早川＊▲, so I couldn't wait to dig in.
Slow down, it's not going to run away. Make sure you actually taste it.
Hey, ▲小早川＊▲. I've been waiting for you. ...Huh？ A grocery bag？
Kobayakawa
Store-bought food on your birthday would be kind of sad, wouldn't it？
...Does that mean you're going to cook for me, ▲小早川＊▲？
That's right. I'm going to use your kitchen... Is that okay？
Yeah. Go ahead and use whatever you need.
...What？ It's hard to work with you staring at me like that.
Right, sorry! I'll just wait and look forward to when it's done, then.
Here you go. My own special homemade cooking.
Whoa, didn't you go all out today？
Well... it is your birthday, after all. I can't guarantee how it tastes, though... How is it？
▲小早川＊▲？ Come on in.
Kobayakawa
Hehe. Sorry for the wait. I got held up doing some shopping.
Shopping...？
I told you I'd make it a birthday you'll never forget, right？ So tonight, I'm going to cook for you▼
Really？ That makes me really happy.
I'm going to put my all into making it, okay？ Look forward to it.
(▲小早川＊▲'s really fired up today, so I'm extra excited for this.)
Ta-da.
Whoa, amazing. You made all of this, ▲小早川＊▲？
Yeah. I just followed the recipe, though... I hope you like it. Come on, try some？
That was really good. You've gotten better at cooking, haven't you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
I see. Well, I'm glad you liked it.
And hey... Is that behind you a present for ●, by any chance？
Yeah, it is. Why'd you have to spot it before I could give it to you？ ...Here.
Because you were taking so long to give it to me.
I was trying to figure out the right timing, you know. Well, I was going to give it to you anyway, so whatever.
Home-cooked food and a present from my girlfriend on my birthday... ● sure is a lucky guy.
You're exaggerating. Getting that excited over it just makes it sound fake.
I'm not faking it, I'm seriously happy. Thanks, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Yeah.
You said you couldn't guarantee the taste, but it was delicious.
Kobayakawa
I see. I'm glad. ...Also, here.
A present？ Are you sure？
It's your birthday, so of course I'm sure.
A present on top of a home-cooked meal, huh. I'm really happy.
You're really that happy about it, huh.
Well, any guy would be happy if his girlfriend did all this for him.
I see. ...Then maybe it was worth working so hard on it.
Yeah, this has been the best birthday ever. Thanks.
Well, I'm your girlfriend, so... of course.
I more than liked it. The food was delicious.
Kobayakawa
Thank goodness. ...Honestly, I was worried about what I'd do if it didn't turn out well.
And also...
Here. A birthday present.
You already cooked for me, and you got me a present too？
Well, wouldn't it be weird not to have a present on your birthday？
Just the home-cooked meal alone made ● super happy, though.
I hope... you like it.
You picked it out for me, right, ▲小早川＊▲？ Then there's no way I wouldn't like it.
Really？ Then make sure you treasure it forever, okay？
Kobayakawa
All right, I should probably head home soon.
Sorry for keeping you this late. I'll walk you home.
Yeah... Actually, never mind. I can walk home by myself.
...All right, get home safe, then.
Yeah... Is that it？
What do you mean, is that it...？
Hey... Aren't you gonna do anything？ Your girlfriend's about to leave, you know？
...Alright, I'm heading home.
Thanks for today. It was a great birthday.
...I'm glad you liked it. See ya.
Kobayakawa
Oh... I really should get going.
Is it that late already？
I know you don't want me to leave, but I have to go home eventually, right？
I guess that's true, but...
Having a boyfriend who gets lonely so easily is rough, honestly.
Who're you calling lonely...？ Well, okay, I am a little lonely.
Then aren't you gonna do what you always do, Mr. Lonely？ Come on... hold me tight...
How's that？ Not so lonely anymore, right？
Yeah. That might've been the best birthday present of all.
Why do you gotta say stuff like that... Well, as long as you're happy. See ya.
Kobayakawa
It's this late already, huh.
Come on, you should head home soon or your parents'll worry.
Quit acting like you're so much older than me.
Hey, quick question before I go... How was your birthday？
I was really happy I got to celebrate it with you, ▲小早川＊▲.
I'm glad you liked it. So... can I ask a favor of my own now？
A favor？ What is it？
A reward. ...Come on. Can we... kiss？
Hehe. Thanks▼
...Alright, get home safe.
Yeah. See you later.
Kobayakawa
Hey... You haven't forgotten, have you？ It's coming up pretty soon.
Forgotten what？
...Do you seriously not remember？ I can't believe you'd forget your own girlfriend's birthday.
Just kidding. There's no way I'd forget your birthday, ▲小早川＊▲.
...Sorry, I didn't mean to sound like I was fishing for something. You don't need to do anything special, though.
What about a party or something？
My family threw me a party every year when I was little, sure, but...
Then let's have one.
I don't need anything big like that. I don't care about doing anything special, as long as I get to spend the day with you.
(Is she really okay with just that...？)
▲小早川＊▲. Just as an example, is there anywhere you'd like to go for your birthday？
Kobayakawa
That's kinda sudden... Nowhere in particular.
Even for your birthday？
Okay then, how about karaoke？
That's just what we always do.
That's fine. Oh, let's play fighting games at the arcade, too. And then wrap it up with a live show.
How about a full course of my favorite things？ We don't usually get to hit them all in one day.
Are you sure that's enough？
More than enough. It's not often I get a whole day of nothing but things I love.
(Well, if that's where ▲小早川＊▲ wants to go, I guess it's fine.)
Kobayakawa
▲主人公＊▲. Sorry to keep you waiting.
Happy birthday, ▲小早川＊▲.
Hehe, thanks. Wanna head straight to karaoke first？
About that... Are you sure you want today's date to just be the usual？
I already told you it's fine. Besides, it's not the same.
Well, yeah... Starting with karaoke and going all the way to a live show, the schedule's like an endurance race.
Exactly. We don't have time to waste, so let's get going.
You could've picked somewhere we don't normally get to go, you know.
It's fine. They just got a new fighting game in, and I wanted to try it out as soon as possible.
Couldn't you do that on a day that isn't your birthday？
Got a problem with that？
Hmm, well, if it makes you happy, ▲小早川＊▲, I guess it's fine.
That's right. I'm gonna put you through the wringer today.
Even if it is your birthday, I'd appreciate it if you went easy on me.
Hehe. I wonder if I should？
Kobayakawa
Man, we really sang a lot!
You're really going all out... Are you gonna be okay for the rest of the day？
I'm fine. Come on, off to the arcade!
Come on, out with it!
I got it, I got it.
If we don't hurry, the show's gonna start.
A-Alright...
Ahh, that was great. Easily the best performance I've seen from them yet.
Glad to hear it...
Hm？ What's wrong？
First we sang all those songs at karaoke, and then all that shouting at the show. My voice is completely shot.
Man, you've got no stamina.
You don't look tired at all, ▲小早川＊▲. You were jumping around the entire show, weren't you？
It's a good kind of tired. Honestly, I could go for another round of karaoke right now.
(Please spare me... What a hectic day...)
Kobayakawa
...Having someone celebrate your birthday is actually pretty nice.
Doesn't your family celebrate it at home too, ▲小早川＊▲？
Well, yeah. But spending your birthday with your boyfriend is special, isn't it？
You think so？
Of course it is. So... thanks. I had a really great time today.
...Haha.
Did I say something funny？
It's just, seeing you say that with a scowl on your face, ▲小早川＊▲... Haha.
Hey, you laughed again! You trying to make me mad？
Sorry, sorry, I won't laugh anymore!
Kobayakawa
Hey. How was today's date？
...Yeah, it was fun.
You don't have to force yourself, you know？
I'm not forcing myself, though... I did get pretty tired.
Still, did you really have fun？
Yeah, no doubt about that!
Okay, as long as that's true. I was worried I was the only one having fun.
Seeing ▲小早川＊▲ look so happy is what made it fun for ●. Even right now.
...It's embarrassing when you stare at me like that.
Haha. You don't have to get that shy.
Kobayakawa
Sorry about today.
Huh!? Why？
I felt like I was being selfish and dragging you around everywhere.
Not at all. It's your birthday, so as long as ▲小早川＊▲ is happy, that's all that matters.
Still, you must be worn out, right？
Well... a little. But I had way more fun than that, really.
Okay, good... Well then.
Hm？
Want to go to karaoke again？
Denied!
Tch!
Oh right, I need to give you your birthday present.
Kobayakawa
For me...？
Who else would it be for？
...Mhm, thanks.
Oh right, I need to give you your birthday present.
Kobayakawa
You didn't have to go out of your way. Just having you spend the day with me made me happy enough.
Just take it. It's from ●.
...I see. Thanks.
Oh right, I need to give you your birthday present.
Kobayakawa
For me？ I wonder what it is.
I hope you like it.
Hehe. Thanks. ...Mind if I open it？
Kobayakawa
Oh, nice! I really like your taste.
Kobayakawa
You really know what I like, huh! Thanks.
Kobayakawa
I've actually been wanting something like this. You really know me. Thanks.
Kobayakawa
Something like this is nice, too. Thanks.
Kobayakawa
So this is the kind of image you have of me？ Huh, that's a new discovery.
Kobayakawa
You put a lot of thought into this for me, huh. Thanks.
Kobayakawa
Huh!? ...Um, this is... Well, I guess it can't be helped.
Kobayakawa
I thought you knew my tastes a little better than this...
Kobayakawa
I can tell you tried hard picking this out, but... yeah, it's the thought that counts.
Kobayakawa
Hey. Are you planning on following me all the way inside？ This is far enough.
Right. Well, see you.
See you later.
▲主人公＊▲。
▲小早川＊▲？
Um, I still have a little bit of time left. And, well...
That's all for today. Um, next year... will you celebrate my birthday again？
Do you even have to ask？
I see. ...Well, see you later, for real this time.
Kobayakawa
Right here is fine.
Got it. ...Hm？ What is it？
Um... Aren't we supposed to do that when we say goodbye？
Eh！？
You could take the lead a little more, you know.
...Yeah. Well, good night.
Good night. Oh, and... I had a really great time today. Thanks.
You're being awfully honest today, ▲小早川＊▲.
You... think so？ Hey, I hope my birthday next year is just as fun as today.
I'll start planning it now. See ya, good night.
Kobayakawa
Well, right here is fine. Time to say goodbye, huh...
You don't have to make it sound like we're parting forever.
Well, today was so much fun that it makes saying goodbye lonely.
I hope my birthday next year, and all the ones after that, are always this much fun...
I'm sure they will be.
Yeah, you're right. Um... Just for a second... okay？
Hehe. I feel better now. Maybe I'll have sweet dreams tonight.
See ya.
Yeah, good night.
Kobayakawa
There were bamboo branches set up around town. Guess it's almost Tanabata...
Come to think of it, that's already next week, huh.
Hey. What kind of wish are you going to make？
●... Well, what about you, ▲小早川＊▲？
Mine is a secret.
Then ● won't tell either.
Ugh, no fair. ...I know. Let's both bring our wish strips on the day of. That works, right？
In that case... sure, though it's a little embarrassing.
Too bad. We're showing them to each other properly. Okay？ You better not back out.
Yeah, got it.
Did you remember to bring your wish strip？
Kobayakawa
Yeah, I brought it.
Let's see what ▲小早川＊▲ wished for...
Hey, come on, don't look yet! What about your wish strip？
Look, here's what ● wrote.
Kobayakawa
▲小早川＊▲？
How can you write something like this...？ What if someone else sees it？
No one's gonna see it, so what does it matter？
Dummy... Hehe.
Here you go.
Kobayakawa
...Is this really... what you wished for？
Yeah. ...Wait, did I say something wrong？
It's Tanabata. Orihime and Hikoboshi. Think about the occasion a little, seriously.
(Did I put her in a bad mood...？)
Actually... I forgot to get a wish strip ready.
Kobayakawa
What!? Seriously？ ...Unbelievable. After you promised me like that.
Sorry!
'Sorry' doesn't cut it. Come on, you're writing one right here, right now.
...Yes.
Kobayakawa
Look, look. That's the Milky Way over there, right？
Then that one's Hikoboshi... and that one over there is Orihime.
I'm glad it's clear out. Now the two lovers actually get to meet.
You and ● are lucky we can see each other whenever we want.
Hey, can I come a little closer？
...Sure. What is it？
I just wanted to be closer to the person I love. So we don't get separated.
And can I ask for one more thing？
It's Tanabata, so sure. What's your wish？
Um... can we... kiss？
Hehe. Think Hikoboshi and Orihime saw us？
They're already setting up for the festival at Towano Shrine. Guess it's that time of year already.
Kobayakawa
Well, it is next month.
Want to go together？
Hmm, I'm going with my friends.
Why？ You don't want to go together？
Because there's a legend about the Towano Festival.
A legend？ Something about the god of love at the shrine, right...？
Yeah. They say if a couple visits the shrine together during the festival, the god gets jealous and makes them break up.
It might just be a legend. But you never know, right？
(I think she's overthinking it, though...)
Kobayakawa
The Towano Festival starts today. I hear it's been crowded since this morning.
By the way, ▲小早川＊▲, are you going with your friends？
Well, I couldn't get a hold of anyone...
Let's just go together, you and ●.
